Reply any time.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first Quartz Collective project up
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on the back burner.

One small thing makes the rest click: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Fifteen minutes and I can walk you through that first project with you, or answer anything over email instead.

Best,
Chidi
